nodes.content: The application is a WordPress installation page (version 6.7.2) that returns identical static HTML for all probed endpoints, including wp-admin, wp-login, wp-json, and even non-existent paths like .env and config.php. No dynamic processing or user input influence on responses is observed, suggesting the site is either in installation mode or using a catch-all routing that serves the same page regardless of URL.
